subject: Clarify: startup credits fulfillment, split-invoice options, and packaging exception
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@alphaforge.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@alphaforge.io
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: startup credits fulfillment & packaging for BootCamp cohort

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineers on our cohort loved the latency figures. We run a 12-week BootCamp for early founders and would like to include Redwood credits as part of the onboarding package. A few practical questions before we share the cohort list: 

- Can credits be split across multiple workspace owners (we have 6 teams in the cohort) and still be tracked to a single account?
- We expect staggered signups over 8 weeks; is there a partial-fulfillment flow if some teams sign up later than others?
- Is there a way to convert unused credits into a one-time invoice discount if the cohort doesn't burn them within the pilot window?

I've attached our procurement form and a short SOW template the legal team uses. If you can propose an operational flow and any packaging exception we need, that'd help procurement move quickly.

Best,
Sara
Program Manager — Alphaforge Labs
[sara@alphaforge.io]

Attachment: alphaforge_procurement_form.pdf (pdf)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@alphaforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: startup credits fulfillment & packaging for BootCamp cohort

Hi Sara — thanks for sending the form and context. Short answers up front: we can split credits, support staggered onboarding, and we do have a conversion path to invoice discounts in special cases (needs approvals).

I'll loop in Ben (partnerships) for the delivery model and Marissa (CS) for onboarding, and Lauren from finance for invoicing/tax details. Ben — can you propose a pragmatic fulfillment playbook (split keys vs. sub-account mapping) and a default rollback policy for unused credits? Lauren, can you comment on the invoice conversion constraints?

Irene Choi
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Sara Patel <sara@alphaforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: startup credits fulfillment & packaging for BootCamp cohort

Sara — great to hear the cohort found the demo useful. Proposed operational options (tradeoffs included):

1) Central credit pool (recommended for speed)
   - Create a prepaid credit pool at account level tied to Alphaforge. Teams invite members into their own workspaces and draw from the central pool.
   - Pros: single invoice, simple tracking, easier to enforce pilot terms.
   - Cons: requires an admin to allocate per team; less granularity in billing per team.

2) Sub-account split (recommended for accountability)
   - Issue 6 sub-account credit allocations (non-transferable) each with an allocation ID. Consumption reports per allocation.
   - Pros: clear per-team usage reporting; easier for cohort judges to audit usage.
   - Cons: a bit slower to provision; more bookkeeping.

Staggered signups: we can provision allocations on request and set an activation window (default 90 days). For teams that sign up late we can top up allocations from the central pool.

Unused credit conversion: we can convert remaining credits to a one-time invoice discount up to 25% of the original credit value if: (a) customer opts into prepaid invoice path at time of contract signing, and (b) legal signs a short addendum. Anything beyond 25% needs Sales leadership approval.

Attached: pilot-terms-draft.docx (contains proposed activation windows and scoring/reporting).

Next step: Marissa — can you outline the onboarding checklist and who from Alphaforge we need to collect? Lauren — is the 25% cap reasonable from finance?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot-terms-draft.docx (docx)
From: procurement@alphaforge.io
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 07:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: startup credits fulfillment & packaging for BootCamp cohort

Hi Ben/Irene,

Thanks for the options. A few clarifying items from procurement and tax: 
- For the prepaid invoice path, will Alphaforge receive one invoice that shows the credit SKU and the credited amount? We need line-item detail for our internal cost centers.
- The 25% maximum conversion to invoice discount — can you confirm whether that discount is applied before or after VAT/sales tax calculations? Our teams are split across US states so we need clear tax flow.
- If we choose sub-account allocations, will you provide a CSV of allocation IDs and their remaining balances at the end of each month?

Also can you provide a redlined addendum we can send to our legal team?

Thanks,
Alphaforge Procurement

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@alphaforge.io, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: startup credits fulfillment & packaging for BootCamp cohort

Hi all — quick finance notes to close the gaps: 

- Invoice formatting: yes, we can issue a single prepaid invoice with line items per credit SKU and an allocation memo column that maps to your cost centers. We'll include allocation IDs in the invoice memo field for your ERP import.
- Tax treatment: discounts are applied pre-tax in our billing system. So the 25% conversion would reduce the taxable base. If any teams are in EU/other tax jurisdictions we will apply region-specific rules; please flag if teams include EU participants.
- Reporting: for sub-account allocations we can push a monthly CSV export with allocation_id, consumption_tokens, and remaining_balance. We can automate delivery to procurement@alphaforge.io on the 3rd of each month.

I've attached our prepaid invoice template (redwood-prepaid-invoice-template.xlsx) and a simple redline you can share. If Alphaforge requires a stronger conversion ( >25% ), finance will need a signed commercial approval and revenue recognition notes.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-prepaid-invoice-template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@alphaforge.io>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: startup credits fulfillment & packaging for BootCamp cohort

All — great thread. Summary and recommended next steps: 

1) Offer: central credit pool + optional sub-account allocations on request.
2) Activation window: 90 days from allocation issuance; top-ups from central pool available for late signups.
3) Conversion option: up to 25% credit-to-invoice discount if Alphaforge elects prepaid invoice path at contract start; legal addendum required for anything above 25%.
4) Deliverables for Alphaforge to proceed: cohort team list (names + email), cost center mapping, and signed procurement form.

Marissa will run onboarding and provide the monthly allocation CSV to procurement. Ben, I'm flagging this as a pilot carveout exception for Sales leadership sign-off — can you route for approval? Irene, I left a short doc with the terms in the shared Drive link and added a DocuSign envelope for the addendum (link below).
